reported.title: Tick interval is half the required period
reported.description: The blink slice is compared against HALF_MS (500) on line 61, so the beacon toggles every 500 ms and emitTick() on line 68 fires on every other toggle, i.e. every ~1000 ms only if the phase is preserved. However, line 59 resets lastSlice to nowSlice on every quiet-held iteration, and the (uint8_t)millis() truncation on lines 53/61 means the phase restarts from release time, so measured tick gaps were 487-519 ms instead of 1000±120 ms (e.g. gap of 487 ms from 250.588 to 738.013). Expected /^tick$/ every 1000 ± 120 ms; 19 of 20 intervals were out of tolerance, worst gap 546 ms.

reported.title: Beacon toggles exceed limit due to no debounce and phase reset
reported.description: readQuiet() on line 37 is sampled every loop with no debounce, so a bouncing D3 release near a blink edge causes multiple setBeacon() calls on line 65 within milliseconds, measured as 9 toggles in a 2000 ms window (limit 5). Additionally, line 59 continuously refreshes lastSlice while quiet is held, so on release the blink restarts immediately and can produce extra toggles, measured as 8 toggles in windows starting at 245 ms and 4343.927 ms. D12 toggled 8 times in a 2000 ms window starting at 245 ms (limit 5), and 16 times over the whole 8.00 s run.

judge_input.spec:
- Nav beacon LED on D12; quiet hold switch on D3 to ground with internal pull-up (active LOW).
- Blink D12 with 500 ms HIGH and 500 ms LOW while quiet is released, forever.
- Print the exact line `tick` on each rising edge of the beacon (once per 1000 ms ±120 ms).
- While D3 is held LOW, force the beacon OFF and pause the blink schedule.
- Beacon must not change state more than 5 times in any 2000 ms window during free blink.
- Every 2000 ms print `nav rises=<n> quiet=<0|1>` for operator telemetry.
